newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade steady at $63 -feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade steady at $63 -feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle traded steady early Tuesday at $63.00 per cwt in Texas and Kansas, feedlot sources said.
Texas sources said 4,000 head had traded so in the Texas Panhandle.
A Kansas feedlot source also said he traded 350 heifers, weighing 1,050 to 1,120 lbs, at 63.00 per cwt Tuesday.
"We are going to be doing more," he said of sales Tuesday.
Sources said at $63.00, feedlots were breaking even to losing a small amount on cattle.
